units: <cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 7:14">Tosef. Ab. Zar. VII</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Avodah Zarah 8:14">VIII</cite>), 14; <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 69b">Ab. Zar. 69ᵇ</cite>, v. <cite ref="O01686"><he>סְתוֹם</he></cite>, a. <cite ref="U02125"><he>שְׁתָם</he></cite>.

senses.gloss: something unknown, undefined. Ib. 74ᵃ bot. סְתַם יינן Ms. M. a. Rashi (ed. יין) wine of gentiles of which it is not known that it has been dedicated to an idol, opp. יין נסך; Ḥull. 4ᵇ.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:10:2">Y. Ab. Zar. III, 43ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>בס׳ חלוקין</he> they differ with regard to a tree (Asherah) of which it is not known that is has been worshipped.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Avodah Zarah 3:10:2">Ib.</cite> <he>סְתָמָן עובדין וכ׳</he> those of them (the gentiles) not otherwise known worship an image but not a tree.
<cite ref="Makkot 3b:14">Macc. 3ᵇ</cite> <he>המלוה את חבירו ס׳</he> he who makes a loan to his neighbor without terms, cannot claim payment before thirty days.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 25b:23">Snh. 25ᵇ</cite> <he>ס׳ גבאי כשר</he> a tax collector, unless known to be dishonest, is admissible as witness; <he>ס׳ רועה פסול</he> a shepherd, unless known to guard his flock from illicit pasture, is disqualified.
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 69a:8">B. Mets. 69ᵃ</cite> (in Chald. dict.) <he>ס׳ אריסא וכ׳</he> the presumption is that a tenant obligates himself, etc.
<cite ref="Rosh Hashanah 7b:5">R. Hash. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>ס׳ כי אגר וכ׳</he> as a rule, when one rents a house etc.; a. v. fr.

senses.gloss: an opinion stated without an authority, anonymous opinion.
units: <cite ref="Yevamot 42b:10">Yeb. 42ᵇ</cite>, a. fr. <he>מחלוקת ואח״כ ס׳ הלכה כס׳</he> where differing opinions are quoted and followed by an anonymous opinion (‘the scholars say’), the latter is the practice.
<cite ref="Chullin 43a">Ḥull. 43ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>הלכה כס׳ משנה</he> the practice follows the anonymous opinion in the Mishnah.
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 86a:3">Snh. 86ᵃ</cite>, a. e. <he>ס׳ מתני׳ ר׳ מאיר וכ׳</he> wherever an anonymous opinion is stated in the Mishnah, it is R. Meïr’s; in the Tosefta, etc.; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sotah 1:8:11">Y. Sot. I, 17ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>כתוב לה ס׳</he> write the order for two men without specified names.
